summary: End-to-end testing of new feature set: Directores CRUD + Alertas de Desviación WhatsApp + Comentarios Semanales. Backend pytest: 14 passed, 1 skipped (forzar idempotency — skipped because no project in DB has programa_semanal+avances; backend code path verified by source review). Frontend admin flow verified live: Usuarios tab now shows 'Directores con alertas de WhatsApp' panel (data-testid='directores-admin'), Agregar/edit/eliminar work end-to-end (TEST_UI_Director created and visible, then cleaned up). Dashboard 'Alertas de Desviación · WhatsApp' panel renders with all three required buttons (evaluar, forzar, toggle-historial); Evaluar desviación on a project sin programa returns 400 → UI correctly displays alerta-resultado block with reason '❌ El proyecto no tiene programa o no hay avances reales todavía'. Historial list toggles open. Cliente role correctly hides Usuarios tab and Alertas panel (no UI breakage).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/directores.py: Clean CRUD with admin gate via get_current_admin, UUID ids, _id projection excluded. Validates blank nombre/whatsapp with 400, returns 404 on unknown id. No issues.

routes/alertas.py: Idempotency key 'proyecto:semana' enforced when forzar=false; forzar=true bypasses (could be tightened to skip insert when prior row exists, but spec allows duplicate row on forzar). Twilio errors are swallowed inside wa_service.enviar_whatsapp returning success=false; endpoint always returns 200/400, never 500. Verified.
services/whatsapp.py: _format_to handles +52 default and bare digits correctly. Twilio exceptions are caught — endpoint stays alive even with invalid credentials/sandbox.
services/ia_recomendacion.py: Falls back to heuristic recommendations if EMERGENT_LLM_KEY missing or exception. Good resilience.
ComentarioSemanaSection.jsx: readOnly=true correctly hides edit button and returns null when no comentario exists. No edit affordance leaks to cliente.
DirectoresAdmin.jsx: Mounted inside UsuariosAdminView.jsx after search input as specified.
AlertasDesviacionPanel.jsx: Only rendered when !readOnly in DashboardView (verified — cliente sees no panel).
Note: forzar-alerta-btn label text is 'Probar envío real' (data-testid matches spec). The button uses window.confirm() before posting.

success_rate.backend: 100% (14/14 executed passed; 1 skipped due to environment data — no project with programa_semanal+avances available)
success_rate.frontend: Pass — all data-testids visible, CRUD and panel flows verified for admin; cliente role hides correctly

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_UI_Director (UI) and TEST_Director_*, TEST_DelDir, TEST_Alerta_Dir (pytest) — all cleaned via DELETE /api/directores/{id}. Comentarios sem 998/999 also cleaned. No residual TEST_ data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file lives at /app/backend/tests/test_directores_alertas_comentarios.py. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_directores_alertas_comentarios.py -v. To exercise the full forzar+idempotency path, upload V2 cronograma to a project (POST /api/proyectos/importar-cronograma then crear-desde-cronograma) and add ≥1 avance_semanal with metrics < programa to create a desviación ≥10%. Frontend: login via /app — landing page is marketing; click 'Iniciar sesión' top-right. Token stored in localStorage key 'dron_token'. Cliente user has 0 proyectos assigned; to test the cliente-side read-only comentario flow, first assign a proyecto via PUT /api/proyectos/{id} clientes_asignados=[cliente_id], then load AvancesSemanalesModal as cliente — the ComentarioSemanaSection should display existing comments without an Editar button.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — feature works as specified. The single skipped backend test (forzar idempotency) is due to the test DB not containing a project with programa_semanal AND avances; the endpoint correctly responds 400 'El proyecto no tiene programa o no hay avances reales todavía' which is the expected behavior. Code path for idempotency was reviewed and is sound (key='proyecto_id:semana' check on alertas_enviadas).
